card.name: Patent claim numbering and punctuation
card.fires_on: Punctuation and spaces right at claim boundaries in patent claims, such as the period after a claim number or the space before the next claim number in 'as recited in' chains. It also fires on 'and' before the last step in a claim list.

modes.label: Claim number boundaries
modes.description: The period or space around claim numbers in repeated 'The method as recited in' phrases.

modes.label: End of claim list
modes.description: The period ending a claim, or the 'and' before the final step, in lists of recording and replaying events.
